liz (PM): Quick thread: we need to lock the audit export format and legal-hold semantics for enterprise launch. Can we pick a single canonical export format that meets legal + archive needs?

diego (eng): I'm leaning toward a compressed JSONL bundle with a signed manifest. WARC is heavy and more web-focused. JSONL is simpler to query.

emma (security): Key requirements: tamper-evident (signed manifest + per-file hashes), timezone-normalized timestamps, and chain-of-custody metadata (who requested/exported).

ton y (legal): For discovery we need an unambiguous record of export time and requester identity. Also ability to freeze retention (legal-hold) for a given tenant or subset of logs.

diego (eng): Proposal: export payload = ZIP {
- manifest.json (signed by our service key)
- records.jsonl.gz (each line: ts, tenant_id, request_hash, metadata, pointer)
- attachments/ (optional full bodies encrypted if customer opted-in)
}
manifest.json fields: root_hash, file_hashes[], signer, timestamp, export_id.

liz (PM): Good. Emma, can we support notarization? e.g., submit root_hash to an external timestamping service?

emma (security): Yes, we can POST root_hash -> TSA and store timestamp token in manifest. But that's extra compliance overhead and cost; mark as "available for enterprise".

diego (eng): Implementation notes: export job will stream records from cold store, compute SHA256 per-record and incremental Merkle tree to produce root_hash. ETA: 2 sprints for MVP export, 1 additional sprint for TSA integration.

ton y (legal): Legal-hold behavior: an admin can set hold at tenant scope or asset scope. Hold semantics: 1) prevent lifecycle deletion, 2) mark items as "frozen" so exports include hold token and cannot be pruned until released. Need audit trail on hold actions.

emma (security): Acceptance tests: simulate hold->attempted-delete->verify retention preserved; verify manifest signature fails if tampered; verify TSA token verifies.

diego (eng): API surface sketches:
POST /v1/tenants/:id/audit/export?from=&to=&include_bodies=(true|false)
POST /v1/tenants/:id/legal-hold {scope: "tenant|recordset", reason: "..."}
GET /v1/tenants/:id/audit/exports/:export_id/status

liz (PM): KPIs we should track: export success rate (target 99.5%), median export duration, average export size, percent of exports with TSA token. Also cost per GB exported by tier.

ton y (legal): We need explicit contract language for customers who enable full-body retention/exports. Also add checkbox consent in onboarding and require an authorized signer for legal-hold requests.

emma (security): Ops ask: storage replication for exported artifacts. We should support cross-region sync and an optional customer-provided bucket (S3) for direct deposit.

diego (eng): We'll add S3 sink option: export -> signed presigned POST to customer bucket, or direct upload if they provide creds. Add encryption at rest via customer CMK if BYOK enabled.

storage-bot: storage-bot: snapshot-service v1.8 promoted to staging (sha: def456) :package:

liz (PM): Owners & timeline: diego -> export pipeline MVP (2 sprints), emma -> security acceptance tests + TSA integration plan (1 sprint), tony -> contract language + legal-hold policy, liz -> onboarding copy + KPI dashboard.

liz (PM): I'll assemble a short launch checklist and follow-up with a PR link. If no objections, I'll mark this thread as the decision record. :white_check_mark:
